description:
Freedom Technology Solutions Group is looking to add an AI Engineer  to the team based out of Washington D.C., Annapolis Junction, or Reston, VA. As a Mid-level AI Engineer with you will be supporting an IC Customer working on mission driven applications.

  

 Candidates in this role will:
 
 
 Ideate, prototype, and deliver AI-enabled solutions in alignment with stakeholders and existing application environments.

 Design, develop, and maintain full stack applications using Next.js, TypeScript, FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, and OpenSearch.

 Use Pydantic (Python) and Zod (TypeScript) for data validation.

 Build and maintain Docker images and deploy, configure, and troubleshoot applications in OpenShift.

 Investigate and resolve production issues across the user interface, backend services, database, and application deployment.

 Work with customers, product owners, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, identify dependencies, and estimate implementation effort.

 Participate in technical design and code reviews, write automated tests, and maintain technical documentation.

 Experience with AWS products.

 Experience with AI observability platforms such as Langfuse and LangSmith.

 Experience developing with agentic AI coding harnesses such as Codex.

 Experience with Next.js AI SDK and FastMCP.

 Familiarity with software development within the Department of War.

 Familiarity with Linux environments and Kubernetes concepts.

 Experience improving application security, accessibility, performance, and reliability.

 Experience working in an Agile development environment and coordinating with product, operations, and security teams. 

 


 Qualifications:

 
 
 9 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Data Science, and/or Software Engineering roles or a highly related field of work with similar scope and responsibilities.

 A Bachelor’s degree may be substituted for 4 years of experience and a Master’s Degree may be substituted for 6 years of experience.

 TS/SCI Clearance with Active CI Polygraph.

 Strong proficiency with at least 1 generative AI framework which includes but is not limited to: LangChain, haystack by deepset, and LlamaIndex among others.

 Strong proficiency in prompt engineering and prompt management.

 Experience with developing agentic AI-solutions including MCP, tool development, context engineering, and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication.

 Strong proficiency in React.js and TypeScript, including functional components, hooks, reusable component design, and API integration.

 Strong experience developing backend services and REST APIs using Node.js or Python.

 Proficiency with PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, SQL, schema migrations, indexing, and query optimization.

 Hands-on experience with Docker, including writing Dockerfiles, building images, and troubleshooting containers.

 Strong communication skills and the ability to translate business and customer needs into clear technical requirements.

 



  

 What’s in It for You? 

 Flexible work environment

 A team mentality – work with friendly, like-minded professionals

 Work with innovative, cutting edge technologies

 Enjoy extremely competitive compensation and benefits

 A work-life balance you can count on

 Opportunities to grow and advance your career on our dime

  

 The Benefits You Get with Freedom 

 Amazing benefits including matching 401k, fully paid medical, and more

 Generous paid time off – including paid site closure days

 Competitive salary offerings

 Paid training and tuition reimbursement

 Referral bonuses

 Fully paid life and disability

 Annual logo wear allowance

 Company sponsored events (game nights, holiday party, summer party, happy hours)

 Interested in learning more about Freedom and our culture?  Contact us today!  We’re constantly hosting hiring events in our office and elsewhere, to help you get a sense of what life is like at Freedom before joining the team.

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, age, marital status, disability or veteran status
